early_masking.scope: actual held-out endpoints with specified additions; original posts are unlabeled; account bootstrap is not a population guarantee

history_contamination.scope: synthetic matched account populations; peer comparability is stipulated, not established for real universities

templates.selection: at least 6 posts and 24 late intervals, >=2 intervals/post, up to 12 posts by SHA256(id); no anomaly-label selection

trajectory_stress.scope: known-reference synthetic generator on fixed historical observation masks; not a validated organic model or empirical manipulation recall

calibration_repeats.design: post-hoc diagnostic with 20 new independent calibration/test pairs; original result retained

trajectory_stress.dose_caveat: shared and independent reaction pulses use the same per-post expected dose and eligibility on fixed dates; realized doses still fluctuate
